clips.text_zh: Nvidia最近獲得了5000億美元投資，以發展其AI基礎設施。這筆資金來自多個主要投資者。這顯示了投資者對AI技術的信心。
clips.text_en_b1: Nvidia recently received a massive investment of $500 billion. This money came from several major investors and is meant for developing AI infrastructure. This investment shows that many people believe in the future of AI technology. Companies want to use AI to improve business and create new products. Nvidia is a leader in AI, and this funding will help them grow even more. The move has attracted attention in the tech world and could change how businesses operate.
clips.text_en_b2: Nvidia has recently secured a groundbreaking investment of $500 billion from multiple major investors aimed at developing its AI infrastructure. This enormous financial backing reflects a strong belief in the potential of AI technology. As companies increasingly seek to leverage AI for business improvement and innovative product development, Nvidia's leadership in the AI sector positions it well for future growth. The scale of this investment has garnered significant attention in the technology community, potentially reshaping the landscape of business operations in various industries.

clips.text_zh: 特朗普媒體最近報告了2.38億美元的虧損，因為加密貨幣市場出現下跌。這使得公司的前景變得不明朗。
clips.text_en_b1: Trump Media recently reported a significant loss of $238 million. This loss is due to the fall in the cryptocurrency market. The decrease in crypto prices has created uncertainty about the company's future. Many investors are worried about how this will affect Trump Media's operations. The company's plans for growth may also be impacted. Investors are now watching closely to see how it will recover from these losses.
clips.text_en_b2: Trump Media has disclosed a substantial loss of $238 million, largely attributed to the recent downturn in the cryptocurrency market. This significant financial setback has raised concerns regarding the company's future prospects. As cryptocurrency prices have plummeted, investor confidence in Trump Media's strategies has waned, leading to heightened scrutiny of its operational decisions. The uncertainty surrounding its growth plans adds further complexity to its recovery efforts, prompting investors to closely monitor the company's next moves in the challenging market environment.
clips.source_hint: Trump Media's financial report amidst crypto decline.

clips.text_zh: 科技領袖最近表示，AI將使人們的工作減少，但許多員工卻表示他們每周工作長達90小時，這樣的情況令人擔憂。
clips.text_en_b1: Recently, tech leaders claimed that AI will reduce the number of jobs available. However, many employees report working up to 90 hours a week. This contradiction raises concerns about the actual impact of AI on the workforce. While companies expect to use AI to be more efficient, workers feel pressure to work longer hours. The debate continues on how AI will really change jobs in the future and what this means for people.
clips.text_en_b2: Tech leaders have recently asserted that AI will lead to a reduction in available jobs, yet many employees report working as much as 90 hours per week. This stark contradiction raises significant concerns regarding the true implications of AI on the workforce. While companies anticipate enhanced efficiency through AI integration, workers are experiencing heightened pressure to extend their working hours. The ongoing debate surrounding the transformative impact of AI on employment raises important questions about its future effects on job security and work-life balance.
clips.source_hint: Tech leaders' statements about AI and job hours.

clips.text_zh: 香港的一個調解機構宣佈已經準備好應對國家糾紛，並希望成為亞洲的法律樞紐，這對香港的法律界是一個重要的進展。
clips.text_en_b1: A mediation body in Hong Kong announced that it is ready to handle state disputes. This organization aims to become a legal hub in Asia. This progress is significant for Hong Kong's legal community. By preparing for more complex cases, the body hopes to strengthen its role in regional dispute resolution. This move could attract more international cases to Hong Kong. The development is seen as a key step in enhancing Hong Kong's position in the legal field.
clips.text_en_b2: A mediation body based in Hong Kong has declared its readiness to address state disputes, aspiring to establish itself as a prominent legal hub in Asia. This development represents a significant milestone for Hong Kong's legal community, as it seeks to enhance its capacity to manage more complex legal cases. By positioning itself to tackle regional disputes effectively, the organization aims to attract a higher volume of international cases to Hong Kong. This initiative is viewed as a crucial step in reinforcing Hong Kong's standing within the global legal landscape.
clips.source_hint: Announcement by a Hong Kong mediation body.

clips.text_zh: 《英雄聯盟》最近迎來了S15賽季，許多職業選手如FNC Vladi正在突破新的紀錄，讓粉絲們期待更多精彩的比賽。
clips.text_en_b1: League of Legends has entered the S15 season, and many professional players are breaking new records. For example, FNC Vladi achieved a record of 5,000 LP. Fans are excited about the upcoming matches. The competition is fierce, and players are showing great skills. This season promises many exciting games. Fans are eager to see how their favorite teams perform and who will come out on top.
clips.text_en_b2: The competitive landscape of League of Legends has entered an exhilarating phase with the commencement of the S15 season, where numerous professional players, notably FNC Vladi, have achieved remarkable milestones, including reaching an impressive 5,000 LP. This unprecedented achievement has ignited enthusiasm among fans, who are eagerly anticipating a series of thrilling matches. As the competition intensifies, players are showcasing their exceptional skills and strategies. This season is set to deliver numerous exciting encounters, leaving fans keenly interested in the performances of their favorite teams and their potential to secure victory.
clips.source_hint: S15 season updates in League of Legends.

clips.text_zh: MMA最近受到了更多關注，許多健身愛好者開始參加訓練班，這也促進了健身房的增長。
clips.text_en_b1: MMA has gained more attention recently. Many fitness fans are joining training classes to learn the sport. This trend has led to an increase in gym memberships. People appreciate the fitness benefits and skills of MMA. With more classes available, many are excited to start training. This growth in interest is changing the fitness scene, making MMA more popular among enthusiasts.
clips.text_en_b2: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) has recently experienced a surge in popularity, leading to a growing number of fitness enthusiasts enrolling in training classes to learn the sport. This rising interest has resulted in increased gym memberships as individuals recognize the fitness benefits and skill development associated with MMA training. The availability of more classes is encouraging numerous participants to embark on their training journeys, contributing to a significant transformation in the fitness landscape and establishing MMA as a favored choice among workout enthusiasts.
clips.source_hint: Growing popularity of MMA training classes.

clips.text_zh: 《進擊的巨人》最近再次受到關注，因為新的動畫季即將推出，吸引了許多粉絲的期待。
clips.text_en_b1: Attack on Titan has gained attention again as a new season of the anime is about to be released. Many fans are excited and discussing the upcoming episodes. This series has a huge following, and people are eager to see what happens next. The story has kept viewers engaged for a long time. Fans are sharing their thoughts online and making predictions about the new season. The excitement is building as the release date approaches.
clips.text_en_b2: The anime series Attack on Titan is once again capturing widespread attention, as a new season is set to premiere soon. Fans are buzzing with excitement and actively engaging in discussions about the forthcoming episodes. With its substantial following, the series has managed to keep viewers captivated for an extended period. As anticipation builds, fans are sharing their insights online and speculating about potential developments in the new season. The excitement around the release date is palpable, promising intense engagement from the community.
clips.source_hint: New season of Attack on Titan announcement.
